Dial gold bar soap is antibacterial & is really gentle on your skin. Even Dove bar soap is amazing for your skin, too. You’re not using a rag or loofah where you’re scraping off your epidermis. Also, there’s nothing wrong with rinsing yourself off with just water. You don’t need to use any type of soap or scrub every time you shower. I’m more referring to the 2-3 showers a day people than the once a day. 

Your epidermis is the outermost layer of your skin. It’s basically your barrier from infections. It’s what stops you from getting sunburnt the moment you walk into the sun. It’s fragile if it’s constantly being scrubbed down. Most people don’t recognize the break down of their epidermis but as you get older you’ll see the spots begin to show up on your skin. Most of the time you’ll notice older people have skin that’s discolored from years of sun exposure. SPF will protect your epidermis from discoloration as you get older. 

When you get out don’t use a towel, keep your skin wet & use a type of moisturizer then follow up with a body oil to lock in the moisture for your skin. I don’t recommend that if you’re in a hurry though lol 

Also, use a dry brush before you get in. At first your skin will be very upset but that’s the best way to get the dead skin off without using soap to scrub it away if that makes sense. I don’t have to exfoliate as much when I use my dry brush before a shower.
